description: Use this skill when deciding which Salesforce fields to encrypt at rest, choosing between deterministic and probabilistic schemes, and managing tenant secrets and keys. Trigger keywords: Shield Platform Encryption, data at rest, AES-256, tenant secret, BYOK, key rotation, encrypted search. NOT for TLS/transport encryption, Classic Encrypted Text fields, or masking without Shield — use architect/salesforce-shield-architecture.
inputs: List of fields (standard or custom) that must be encrypted and their data types
Compliance mandate (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc.) driving the encryption requirement
Whether the fields need to be searchable or filterable after encryption
Shield Platform Encryption license status for the org
Key management preference: Salesforce-managed, BYOK, or Cache-Only Keys
name: platform-encryption
official_sources: Salesforce Security Guide (262) — Shield Platform Encryption overview, "set encrypted data permissions" (secguide 262 L303-306); criteria-based sharing rules can't use encrypted fields (L3478-3479); existing data, history and `FieldHistoryArchive` behaviour (L4899-4904); Classic Encryption and View Encrypted Data (L2483-2548).

Object Reference (264) — `TenantSecret`: KDF seed description and rotation limits (obj 264 L283642-283645), `KeyDerivationMode` (L283671-283683), `Source` HSM/Uploaded/Remote (L283743-283769), `Status` Active/Archived/Destroyed (L283771-283786), export/import before destroy (L283928-283929), cache-only reactivation (L283943-283944); Cache-Only Key Service add-on (L134305-134306).

Metadata API Developer Guide (264) — `CustomField.encryptionScheme` values (api_meta 264 L45623-45630); deterministic filters with equals/not equals (L33328-33329); `PlatformEncryptionSettings` incl. `enableDeterministicEncryption` and `enableEncryptFieldHistory` (L127844-127896); `EncryptionKeySettings.enableCacheOnlyKeys` / `enableReplayDetection` (L118655-118692); enhanced lookups description (L44305-44311).
Platform Events Developer Guide (264) — Key Management and Encryption Policy pages (platform_events 264 L5732-5733); `RemoteKeyCalloutEvent` (L15274).

Further reading, not corpus (Help-only, used only for claims marked UNVERIFIED): Shield Platform Encryption Implementation Guide — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.security_pe_overview.htm&type=5 ; Which Custom Fields Can I Encrypt? — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=xcloud.security_pe_custom_fields.htm&type=5 ; KB 000382508 (View Encrypted Data and Shield) — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000382508&type=1
outputs: Field encryption scheme recommendation (probabilistic vs deterministic per field)
Key management strategy and rotation plan
List of fields that cannot be encrypted with rationale
Search/filter impact assessment and mitigation approach
